findings: The selected candidate contains a false verbatim quotation. It says “A reject system using an air cylinder and push rod is located on the cartoner discharge coveyor.” The acquired page image prints “conveyor,” not “coveyor.” This violates the explicit requirement to retain the exact corrected industrial quote.

The construction plan does not yet provide explicit, testable initial assumptions for the open flaps’ dimensions, mass, hinge limits, damping, or contact/friction parameters. It merely defers these parameters to later native verification. Native validation properly remains a later gate, but construction readiness still requires conservative numerical starting values so the pinned-YAM build can be attempted reproducibly.

The principal geometry is otherwise internally consistent: the representative body is 120×70×70 mm, the z=15–40 mm contact band lies within the body, and the nominal 94 mm pad opening is correctly described as source-model evidence rather than measured grasp clearance. The source images also support the FEFCO 0201 structure and Rovema’s pneumatic open-flap rejection mechanism, while the robotic sidewall pinch is appropriately disclosed as a proposed alternative.
